title: Add mood_state and user_state to db/models.py
description:
Extend chatbot/db/models.py with persistence fields and tables for mood and user state.

Add these columns to the existing Session model:
- mood_state: JSON (nullable) — serialized MoodState snapshot from chatbot.soul.mood
- user_state: JSON (nullable) — serialized UserState snapshot from chatbot.soul.user_state
- conversation_mode: str (nullable) — current ConversationMode label

Add a new table BotMoodLog:
- id: UUID pk, server_default gen_random_uuid()
- session_id: FK -> Session.id, indexed
- mood: str
- energy: float
- closeness: float
- created_at: UTC datetime, server_default now()

Add a new table UserStateLog:
- id: UUID pk, server_default gen_random_uuid()
- session_id: FK -> Session.id, indexed
- primary_state: str (nullable)
- confidence: float
- evidence_summary: text (nullable)
- created_at: UTC datetime, server_default now()

Use the same SQLAlchemy 2.0 Mapped[] style as the existing models. Import and follow patterns from the existing chatbot/db/models.py. Do NOT redefine Base, User, Session, Message, Episode, SemanticFact, or Entity — extend the existing model classes in place.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task k.4)
- chatbot/db/models.py (the existing file with User, Session, Message, Episode, SemanticFact, Entity)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
